announcements.headline: Results of Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: Routine shareholder ratification of AGM resolutions carries negligible fundamental impact on Corpus Resources' valuation or operational trajectory within the critical raw materials sector.

announcements.headline: Half-Year Results to 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: As a small-cap miner, COR's half-year results are highly sensitive to copper price volatility and operational execution at the Kipushi mine; strong guidance here could trigger a re-rating given the current supply deficit narrative in base metals.

announcements.headline: Restoration of Listing and Trading
announcements.insight: Restoration of listing is a critical survival mechanism for COR, directly addressing the liquidity crisis and delisting risk that has plagued the stock; without this, the company faces existential threats to its capital raising ability and shareholder value.

announcements.headline: Annual Financial Report
announcements.insight: As a small-cap explorer, the release of an annual report provides essential baseline data for valuation but lacks the transformative catalysts typical of high-impact news; investors will scrutinize reserve updates and cash burn rates against current base metal price volatility.
